attributes.description: The original URL the user saved. Canonicalized (scheme + host lowercased) before storage.
attributes.name: url

attributes.description: Human-readable title resolved from the page; falls back to the host when none is available.
attributes.name: title

attributes.description: When the link was first saved. Immutable once set.
attributes.name: savedAt

entities.description:
A single saved URL belonging to one user — the atom of the library. Carries the
original URL, a resolved title, and the moment it was saved.
entities.name: Link

attributes.description: The tag label, case-insensitive and unique per user. De-duplicated on write.
attributes.name: name

entities.description:
A user-scoped label applied to links. The only organizing primitive in the product;
retrieval is by tag, not by folder.
entities.name: Tag

attributes.description: The collection's display name, set by the curator.
attributes.name: name

attributes.description: One of `draft` or `published`; `published` exposes the share token, `draft` keeps it private.
attributes.name: status

attributes.description: Opaque token that resolves the published collection read-only; null while draft or after revocation.
attributes.name: shareToken

entities.description:
A named, ordered set of a user's links that a curator can publish as a read-only
share. Holds its publication state and, when published, a share token.
entities.name: Collection

invariants.statement:
Every Link, Tag, and unpublished Collection belongs to exactly one owning user, and is
readable only by that user — the sole exception being a Collection in `published` status,
which is readable by anyone presenting its current `shareToken`.
